name: Crank drive X
description: Drives the X component of uniform circular motion about a fixed center, at a live angular rate -- the standard identity d/dt[r cos(theta)] = -omega*(y-y0) for a point rotating at constant omega, which needs no separate angle state to track. Connect from a fixed Free body (the pivot) to another Free body (the crank pin); pair with Crank drive Y for the Y component. The radius is whatever the initial distance between the two happens to be -- preserved by the motion itself, not set as a parameter.
